items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: you had a song like Glenn Miller, you know, all the rest of them

ctx.x: But I wouldn't play them with a Dixieland band.

I'd play them with a big band, see? Because although you weren't getting the money, you had a song like Glenn Miller, you know, all the rest of them, you know. But I don't see much difference in the style of dancing, except young people, they don't dance.
